findings.title: Paging function called with page 0
findings.body: `paginate` expects pages numbered from 1, but `pageAtOffset` passes `page = 0` when `offset` is in [0, 24]. This causes the first page to be skipped and the second page to start at index 25, breaking pagination. Pass `page + 1` to `paginate`.

findings.title: Unnecessary Math.floor on integer division
findings.body: Since `offset` and `PAGE_SIZE` are both integers, `offset / PAGE_SIZE` already truncates toward zero, making `Math.floor` redundant. Remove it for clarity.

summary.problem: The new paging helper misaligns page numbers and uses an unnecessary floor operation.
summary.done_well: The offset validation and the import of the paging utility are correct.
